About Me

Hi, I'm Aysha

I work in the space where ideas turn into content people actually feel something from. My background is in social media, content strategy, copywriting, production, client coordination, and set design — which means I'm not just focused on how content is posted, but on how it comes together from the very beginning.

I love the process behind building strong content. Shaping the idea, finding the right angle, refining the message, supporting the production, and making sure the final piece feels polished, intentional, and true to the brand. For me, great content is not just about looking good. It's about making people stop, connect, and remember.

How I Work

Content pillars that drive results

✦
01
Strategy First
Every piece of content starts with a clear goal. I build strategies rooted in audience insight, platform behaviour, and brand voice — before a single post is created.
◈
02
Story-Led Content
Great content makes people feel something. I craft narratives that connect emotionally — whether it's a 15-second reel or a long-form YouTube piece.
◎
03
Platform Mastery
Each platform has its own language. I adapt content natively — TikTok, Instagram, YouTube, LinkedIn, Snapchat — maximising reach and engagement on every channel.
⬡
04
Viral Thinking
I develop content with shareability built in — ideas designed for retention, saves, and organic spread across communities.
◇
05
Brand Integration
Branded content that doesn't feel like an ad. I align campaign messaging with authentic storytelling so audiences engage rather than scroll past.
○
06
Data-Driven Growth
Results matter. I track performance, analyse insights, and continuously optimise to ensure content delivers measurable growth — not just visibility.

Case Studies

Work that delivered

Café Divine Street
F&B / Lifestyle
+
The Challenge
As a boutique café, Café Divine Street needed to build brand awareness, create an engaging community, and stand out in a competitive food & beverage market.
My Strategy
  • Designed an Instagram-first strategy with high-quality food photography and reels
  • Created seasonal campaigns — Ramadan specials, weekend offers — to attract walk-in customers
  • Used geo-targeted paid ads to reach local audiences
Results
65%
Increase in Instagram engagement within 4 months
40%
Organic follower growth strengthening brand visibility
Nescafé
Beverage & FMCG
+
The Challenge
Nescafé wanted to drive engagement among urban coffee lovers in Sri Lanka, promote innovative product collaborations, and reinforce its image as a brand that empowers consumers to create café-style experiences at home.
My Strategy
  • Led the Nescafé × Milkmaid collaboration with creative coffee recipe content
  • Executed the "Be Your Own Barista" influencer campaign with lifestyle creators
  • Developed content calendar combining recipe videos, behind-the-scenes stories, polls and challenges
Results
60%
Increase in social media engagement during campaign periods
40%
Uplift in website visits and recipe downloads
Sanji Caldera Associates
Migration Consultancy
+
The Challenge
Sanji Caldera Associates needed to generate more leads for international migration and student placement services across UAE, Sri Lanka, New Zealand, and Australia.
My Strategy
  • Built a multi-country digital marketing strategy tailored for four markets
  • Created educational and trust-building content — success stories, testimonials, process guides
  • Designed email drip campaigns targeting prospects with relevant migration updates
Results
40%
Increase in lead generation through optimized paid campaigns
25%
Higher email open rates vs. industry average
United Motors
Automotive
+
The Challenge
United Motors wanted to strengthen its digital presence, build excitement for new vehicle launches, and engage a broader audience in Sri Lanka's competitive automotive market.

  • Developed a multi-platform content calendar with lifestyle storytelling and feature highlights

  • Partnered with lifestyle and automotive influencers for test drives and behind-the-wheel content

Imperial College
Education

Imperial College aimed to attract high-potential students, highlight its innovative programs, and strengthen its reputation as a global hub for research and entrepreneurship.
